title: Module test A2.2 · Name and phrase

blocks.text: Module test A2.2 · Name and phrase
Instructions

Week 69 of the calendar, after verification A2-07 → A2-12. Duration: approx. 90 minutes for parts A/D, plus 10– 12 minutes of conversation with the tutor. Work without notes and dictionary; Correct at the end with the solution. Part B script is at the beginning of solutions: let another person read it or paste it into a voice synthesis app without reading it.

rows: Language: description, plurality, iḍāfa, suffixes, comparatives, numbers

blocks.text: Overcoming. At least 38 points above 50 (75%) and at least 2 in each criterion of the headings. If you do not pass the test, dedicate the week after the weakest unit (look where you lost more points in part C) and repeat the test with the tutor.
A · Reading (10 points)
⁧لُوكَا⁩ : ⁧إِلَى⁩ · ⁧طَارِق⁩ : ⁧مِنْ⁩
⁧عَزِيزِي لُوكَا،⁩
⁧شُكْرًا عَلَى رِسَالَتِكَ. سَأَلْتَنِي عَنِ الشَّقَّةِ وَعَنِ الحَيِّ، وَهٰذِهِ بَعْضُ المَعْلُومَاتِ.⁩
⁧الشَّقَّةُ فِي الطَّابِقِ الثَّالِثِ مِنْ عِمَارَةٍ قَدِيمَةٍ بَيْضَاءَ فِي شَارِعٍ هَادِئٍ. فِيهَا غُرْفَتَا نَوْمٍ، وَصَالَةٌ كَبِيرَةٌ، وَمَطْبَخٌ⁩
⁧صَغِيرٌ، وَشُرْفَةٌ تُطِلُّ عَلَى حَدِيقَةٍ. هِيَ أَصْغَرُ مِنْ شَقَّتِي، لٰكِنَّهَا أَهْدَأُ بِكَثِيرٍ. الإِيجَارُ لِأُسْبُوعَيْنِ ثَلَاثُمِئَةِ يُورُو،⁩
⁧وَهٰذَا أَرْخَصُ مِنْ أَيِّ فُنْدُقٍ فِي الحَيِّ.⁩
⁧الدُّقِّي حَيٌّ كَبِيرٌ فِي الجِيزَةِ، عَلَى الضِّفَّةِ الغَرْبِيَّةِ لِلنِّيلِ. شَوَارِعُهُ أَكْثَرُ ازْدِحَامًا مِنْ شَوَارِعِ الزَّمَالِكِ، لٰكِنَّ⁩
⁧الأَسْعَارَ فِيهِ أَقَلُّ. فِي شَارِعِنَا ثَلَاثَةُ مَطَاعِمَ وَصَيْدَلِيَّتَانِ وَمَحَلٌّ لِلْخُضَارِ. مَحَطَّةُ المِتْرُو عَلَى بُعْدِ عَشْرِ دَقَائِقَ⁩
⁧مَشْيًا، وَالمَرْكَزُ أَقْرَبُ: خَمْسُ دَقَائِقَ فَقَطْ.⁩
⁧بَوَّابُ العِمَارَةِ، عَمّ أَحْمَد، رَجُلٌ طَوِيلٌ، شَعْرُهُ أَبْيَضُ، وَعُمْرُهُ أَكْثَرُ مِنْ سَبْعِينَ سَنَةً. يَعْمَلُ فِي العِمَارَةِ مُنْذُ عَامِ⁩
⁧أَلْفٍ وَتِسْعِمِئَةٍ وَتِسْعِينَ، وَيَعْرِفُ كُلَّ السُّكَّانِ وَأَسْمَاءَ أَوْلَادِهِمْ. قَبْلَ ذٰلِكَ كَانَ سَائِقًا فِي شَرِكَةٍ كَبِيرَةٍ.⁩
⁧فِي الدَّوْرَةِ الآنَ أَحَدَ عَشَرَ طَالِبًا، وَأَصْغَرُهُمْ عُمْرُهُ عِشْرُونَ سَنَةً فَقَطْ. أَرْسِلْ لِي رَقْمَ رِحْلَتِكَ، وَسَأُخْبِرُ عَمّ⁩
⁧أَحْمَد بِمَوْعِدِ وُصُولِكَ. طَارِقمَعَ تَحِيَّاتِي،⁩

Reply in English (2 points for complete response, 1 if partial).
1. Describe the apartment: floor, building, rooms, what you see from the balcony.

B · Listening (8 points)
Listen to the commercial twice, with 30 Second pause. Answer in English; 2 points per answer.
1. What does it advertise and where?
2. How much did the model cost?Nūr 5How much is it now, and how much is it?
3. In what the model isNūr 7... is different fromNūr 5And how much does it cost?
4. What do you get with every phone? How long does the offer last, and how many stores does the chain have?
C · Language (12 points)

One point for an answer. Write with your vowels. Description and plurality. 1. Translate: "The sky" ( ⁧السَّمَاء⁩ , feminine) was blue. 2. Write the plural of ⁧مَدِينَة⁩ . · 3. Write the plural of ⁧وَزِير⁩ . Iḍāfa and suffixed. 4. Translate: The new machine of the Director of the Office · 5. Translate: with the bank employees · 6. Translate: "Did you see it?" (you, m.) · 7. Translate: "I gave it to him." ⁧إِيَّا⁩ ) Comparative and superlative. 8. Comparative of ⁧غَالٍ⁩ · 9. Translate: The largest city in the Arab world • 10. Translate: More crowded ( ⁧أَكْثَرُ⁩ Numbers. Write in letters with the name: 11. 3 + ⁧سَاعَة⁩ · 12. 15 + ⁧يَوْم⁩
D · Written production (8 points)

Write about 100 words, vocalized, to an Arabic colleague who will come to Milan for a month and asks you about your neighborhood. Obligatory elements: describe a person in the neighborhood (appearance, color of hair or clothes, with ⁧كَانَ⁩ or without); use at least three broken plurals; at least one chain of iḍāfa; compare your neighborhood with another (two comparisons and one superlative); give at least three digits with the name in the right form (prices, distances, years). Evaluation: Accuracy 1–4 + Register 1–4 (heading 6.3). Each missing mandatory item removes 1 Point to Accuracy (minimum 1).
E · Oral production: guided conversation (12 points)
With the tutor, about 10–12 minutes.
1. Who is it? The tutor shows you a person's picture: describe it (age, appearance, clothes, colors) and imagine what it was like
20 years ago, with ⁧كَانَ⁩ .
2. Choose. The tutor presents you three offers (three apartments, three phones or three trips) with prices and
characteristics: compare and choose, motivating.
3. Data and numbers. Role-playing game at the desk: tutor asks you date of birth, address, number of family members,

years of service and the price of something you bought recently. Answer with full sentences. Evaluation: Accuracy 1–4 + Fluidity 1–4 + Speak 1–4. The Pronunciation evaluates the tutor; Without tutoring the E part remains unfinished.
